name: USA Auto Supply Inc.

about:
USA Auto Supply Inc. operates a retail location at 193 W Wingohocking Street in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and a second location on Carr 111 Km.63.2 in Utuado, Puerto Rico. The Philadelphia store is open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM, while the Puerto Rico location operates Monday through Friday 8 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 1:30 PM. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials.

The business functions as a nationwide supplier of automotive aftermarket products, stocking car care chemicals, auto detailing supplies, auto body repair materials, and automotive paints and refinishing products. Its catalog includes waxes, tire shines, cleaners, polishes, odor eliminators, and accessories such as microfiber towels, brushes, and applicators. Paint matching services are offered exclusively at the physical stores. The company ships orders via FedEx to customers across the United States.

USA Auto Supply serves professional detailers, auto body shops, and DIY enthusiasts in the automotive aftermarket. Its product range targets the automotive paint supply, car care, detailing, and auto body repair sectors. Customer reviews on the website reference purchases by individual vehicle owners as well as repeat business from detailers who have used specific products for years.

The company emphasizes its paint matching expertise as a core differentiator, promoting it as a specialty service. It also highlights fast shipping via FedEx, a satisfaction guarantee, dedicated phone support, and secure online payments as reasons customers choose it. The Puerto Rico location opened in March 2021, expanding its geographic reach.
